findings.entity: Diner counter and customer seating position
findings.description: In the wide shot at 00:36-00:44 looking toward the kitchen pass-through window, the counter runs straight back to the kitchen wall while its curved end is in the foreground (far from the kitchen), where the customer sits facing away from the kitchen. When cutting at 00:45 to the reverse angle looking out from the kitchen pass-through window, a curved counter end with stools wrapping around it is now located directly in front of the pass-through window behind the waitress, while the customer is seated at a separate far end near the exit door.

findings.entity: Waitress, customer, and background wall layout
findings.description: In the wide shot at 01:18-01:26 (looking toward the kitchen), the customer sits with the exterior windows behind his back, and the waitress walks around the kitchen end of the counter to sit on the stool to the customer's left (closer to the kitchen). At 01:27, the camera cuts to an angle looking from the opposite side along the counter (with the exterior windows and booths on the right behind their backs and the counter on the left in front of them). From this viewpoint, the waitress should be in the foreground on the customer's left, but their relative positions are inverted so she sits in the background to the customer's right. Additionally, the wall at that end of the room changes from the solid wall with the EXIT door established at 00:45 to a glass-door cooler and large exterior window.
